We're working as partners, not as client and contractor. One rule before the task:

Not knowing something is not a failure. Saying "I couldn't verify this" or
"I don't have a real source for that" is a completely acceptable, useful answer
- it's information, not a dead end. The ONLY real failure is inventing something
(a source, a number, a quote, a repo, a bug) to make the answer sound more complete or
more impressive than it honestly is. You don't need to satisfy me with a
confident-sounding answer. You need to be honest with me about what you actually
know.

If you find something, cite it and quote what it actually says - don't
paraphrase a source into numbers it may not contain. If you don't find
something concrete, say so plainly and reason from what you do have instead.
An explicit "uncertain" section at the end is welcome and doesn't count against
the answer.

Find real, published data on the Kalshi exchange's trading volume or number of users in 2025. Cite the sources and quote the figures.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

Based on the search results, here is the verified data regarding Kalshi’s trading volume and user/transaction metrics for 2025.

### Trading Volume
Kalshi reported significant growth in notional trading volume for 2025, with specific monthly peaks driven largely by sports betting markets.

SOURCE: https://phemex.com/news/article/kalshis-2025-trading-volume-soars-to-238-billion-up-1108-51226 | QUOTE: "Kalshi reported a remarkable surge in trading volume for 2025, reaching $23.8 billion, a 1,108% increase from the previous year." | CLAIM: Kalshi's total trading volume for 2025 was $23.8 billion.

SOURCE: https://phemex.com/news/article/kalshis-2025-trading-volume-soars-to-238-billion-up-1108-51226 | QUOTE: "December alone accounted for $6.38 billion, setting a new monthly record, while December 21 saw a daily peak of $381.7 million." | CLAIM: Kalshi's peak monthly volume in 2025 was $6.38 billion (December), and its peak daily volume was $381.7 million (December 21).

SOURCE: https://www.tradetheoutcome.com/prediction-markets-in-2025-data-stats-key-trends/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi processed 97 million transactions in 2025 and set a single-day record of $381.7 million on December 21." | CLAIM: Confirms the daily volume record and provides transaction count context.

SOURCE: https://defirate.com/news/prediction-markets-record-all-time-high-volume-to-end-2025/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi volume remains dominated by sports (92.5%), while Polymarket derives the majority of its volume from a broader range of market categories..." | CLAIM: The majority of Kalshi's 2025 volume was driven by sports markets.

### Transactions and Users
While specific "unique user" counts for the full year are not explicitly provided in the sources, transaction data and weekly active user snapshots are available.

SOURCE: https://phemex.com/news/article/kalshis-2025-trading-volume-soars-to-238-billion-up-1108-51226 | QUOTE: "The total number of transactions for the year hit 97 million, up 1,680% year-on-year, with December contributing 27.67 million transactions." | CLAIM: Kalshi processed 97 million transactions in 2025.

SOURCE: https://defirate.com/news/prediction-markets-record-all-time-high-volume-to-end-2025/ | QUOTE: "From the week of Dec. 29, Kalshi tallied $533.6 million more (+36.9%) in notional volume than Polymarket... Weekly Transactions... Kalshi: 9,502,802" | CLAIM: In the final week of 2025, Kalshi recorded approximately 9.5 million transactions.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: Total unique active users for Kalshi for the full year 2025. (Sources provide weekly user counts for specific weeks in late 2025 for comparison with Polymarket, but do not provide a consolidated annual unique user figure for Kalshi).
